739:    """Builds einsum equations for the attention computation.
740:
741:    Query, key, value inputs after projection are expected to have the shape as:
742:    `(bs, <non-attention dims>, <attention dims>, num_heads, channels)`.
743:    `bs` and `<non-attention dims>` are treated as `<batch dims>`.
744:
745:    The attention operations can be generalized:
746:    1. Query-key dot product:
747:        (<batch dims>, <query attention dims>, num_heads, channels),
748:        (<batch dims>, <key attention dims>, num_heads, channels) ->
749:        (<batch dims>, num_heads, <query attention dims>, <key attention dims>)
750:    2. Combination:
751:        (<batch dims>, num_heads, <query attention dims>, <key attention dims>),
752:        (<batch dims>, <value attention dims>, num_heads, channels) -> (<batch
753:        dims>, <query attention dims>, num_heads, channels)
754:
755:    Args:
756:        rank: Rank of query, key, value tensors.
757:        attn_axes: List/tuple of axes, `[-1, rank)`,
758:            that attention will be applied to.
759:
760:    Returns:
761:        Einsum equations.
762:    """
763:    target_notation = ""
764:    for i in range(rank):
765:        target_notation += _index_to_einsum_variable(i)
766:    # `batch_dims` includes the head dim.
767:    batch_dims = tuple(np.delete(range(rank), attn_axes + (rank - 1,)))
768:    letter_offset = rank
769:    source_notation = ""
770:    for i in range(rank):
771:        if i in batch_dims or i == rank - 1:
772:            source_notation += target_notation[i]
773:        else:
774:            source_notation += _index_to_einsum_variable(letter_offset)
775:            letter_offset += 1
776:
777:    product_notation = "".join(
778:        [target_notation[i] for i in batch_dims]
779:        + [target_notation[i] for i in attn_axes]
780:        + [source_notation[i] for i in attn_axes]
781:    )
782:    dot_product_equation = "%s,%s->%s" % (
